newsitem.title: NORWAY: Maritime poised for Oseberg deal - source.
newsitem.headline: Maritime poised for Oseberg deal - source.

text.p: Norwegian offshore subcontractor Aker Maritime is expected to win a contract for the construction of the topside for Norsk Hydro's Oseberg gas platform, an industry source said on Tuesday.
The contract is worth 1.3 billion crowns.
"Aker Maritime has been recommended for the contract, but no final decision will be taken until later this week," the source told Reuters.
Aker Maritime is also favoured to win a deal to build the platform jacket, a contract worth nearly 400 million crowns.
The source said operator Norsk Hydro had told its partners in the development it wanted Aker Maritime to build the topside.
A Hydro spokeswoman said an announcement on awarding the topside and jacket contracts would be made at the end of the week.
Aker Maritime is competing with Norwegian industrial group Kvaerner ASA and some foreign bidders for the contracts.
The gas platform, which will come on stream around the year 2000, will be connected to the existing Oseberg Field Centre.
